run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run. The same hard egress constraint seen on recent runs persisted: the session network policy denied all direct HTTPS to tender hosts. WebFetch returned DNS ENOTFOUND for the first hosts attempted (www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au), so per environment guidance no further direct fetches were attempted. No buyer-originated portal, detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened; discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool (US-indexed, returning mostly cached snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au; WA/SA/TAS; NT QTOL; ACT) swept by search only. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel and own sites; universities/TAFEs; water corporations and other GBEs; public health) checked by search; several genuinely new buyer-originated local-government and GBE sources were identified and recorded. Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery/Business Network; BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside; major retail/bank/telco/utility supplier portals) checked by search - every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx; recorded as portals only, none fabricated. One genuinely open, recently-published and well-corroborated buyer-originated opportunity was surfaced and confirmed against the buyer's own page via search (National Library of Australia NLA26/817 Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance Services, opened 6 Nov 2026, closing 23 Dec 2026). One further recent local-government EOI (SSROC FOGO caddies and liners) is carried at headline level and flagged UNVERIFIED because it could only be seen in an aggregator snippet and could not be confirmed on the SSROC live page this run. Known carryovers already in the aggregate (e.g. Coliban Water Field Services RFT, closing reported 15 Dec 2026; DFAT PNG opportunities) were not re-asserted this run due to the egress block. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated; leads that resolved to closed or awarded notices were excluded and noted in gaps.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK: all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy (WebFetch DNS ENOTFOUND - hosts outside allowed domains). This has blocked full discovery on multiple consecutive runs. To restore full discovery, at minimum these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au and buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, www.library.gov.au, ssroc.nsw.gov.au, and individual council/university/utility sites.

NLA26/817 (National Library of Australia) was confirmed at the identity/scope level from the Library's own 'Approach the Market' page via search snippets, but the tender documents themselves could not be opened (egress block), so deliverables list, mandatory conditions, eligibility, evaluation criteria, submission mechanics, value and contact are not yet captured and need a detail pass.

SSROC FOGO caddies and liners EOI (closing reported 8 Dec 2026) is UNVERIFIED: it appeared only in a single aggregator snippet (posting date ~12 Nov 2026); the SSROC live tenders page could not be opened and the cached version showed only older references (T2025-12, T2026-02). Reference number, documents and exact scope not confirmed.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, major banks) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tender fabricated.

Excluded leads (not fabricated - resolved to closed/awarded notices): Emerald Hospital Renal Dialysis Chairs Unit D&C EOI (Health Infrastructure Queensland) closed 8 May 2026 and awarded to Paynters - excluded. Queanbeyan Sewage Treatment Plant Upgrade D&C EOI (Queanbeyan-Palerang Regional Council, ref EOI-2013388) listed as closed, published 8 May 2026 - excluded. RFT26-002 'From Pipeline to Bankable Project' EOI (Palladium International, Quad Infrastructure Fellowships) closed 13 Sep 2026 - excluded. RFT26-001/004/006 EOI series (Ports of the Future; Sustaining Infrastructure; Grid-Connected Solar) all previously closed - excluded.

Unconfirmed / dropped leads: NGV (National Gallery of Victoria) 'Mechanical and Electrical Services' (aggregator ID 624112) marked 'current' but no closing date or buyer-originated confirmation found - not captured. Springwood Aquatic Centre HVAC supply/installation (closing reported 1 Dec 2026) and a 'Water and Wastewater Condition Assessment' (ref Cn2027-025, closing 3 Dec 2026) appeared in aggregator snippets with no confirmed issuing body - not captured. DFAT-1113 'PNG Health Program ENABLE' EOI could not be confirmed: DFAT's own notification page describes only an intent to approach the market for the ENABLE managing contractor from 2027, with no tender number or closing date - a reported '1 December 2026' date could not be corroborated, so not captured.
WebSearch is US-indexed and returned predominantly stale or aggregator data; genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.

tenders.title: Approach to Market - Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance Services (NLA26/817)
tenders.category: Facilities management - mechanical and electrical (building services) maintenance
tenders.description: The National Library of Australia has approached the market for the provision of on-site preventative and corrective maintenance of the critical electrical and mechanical assets at its main building in Parkes, ACT and its storage facility at Hume, ACT. The approach to market opened on 6 November 2026 and closes on 23 December 2026 at 5:00 PM AEDT.
tenders.deliverables_summary: On-site maintenance of the Library's critical electrical and mechanical building assets, and the records pertaining to them, to support the Library's operability and its collection-preservation mandate. Confirmed scope is at summary level; the discrete maintenance deliverables and service levels are set out in the tender documents, which could not be opened this run (egress block).
tenders.scope_of_work: Per the Library's 'Approach the Market - Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance Services' page: maintaining the Library's critical electrical and mechanical assets and the records that pertain to them, in support of the Library's operability and collection-preservation mandate. The Library's main building is in Parkes, ACT; it also owns a storage facility at Hume, ACT. Full technical scope and schedules are in the tender documents (not accessible this run).
tenders.eligibility: Open approach to market (publicly advertised). Specific eligibility, licensing and prequalification requirements are in the tender documents and were not accessible this run.
tenders.submission_method: Via the National Library of Australia's tender process / document access link on the Library tenders page (exact lodgement mechanics not confirmed this run).
tenders.delivery_location: Canberra, ACT - main building at Parkes and storage facility at Hume
tenders.detail_source: National Library of Australia 'Approach the Market - Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance Services' page (read via WebSearch snippet; direct page fetch blocked by egress). Status 'open', ID NLA26/817, closing 23 Dec 2026 5:00 PM AEDT, opened 6 Nov 2026, scope and site locations confirmed from that page.
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via WebSearch and confirmed against the buyer's own domain (library.gov.au) - the NLA 'Approach the Market' page for Mechanical and Electrical Maintenance Services. This is a buyer-originated Commonwealth approach to market, genuinely open and recently published (6 Nov 2026). Recorded against the Library's own source, not an aggregator.
tenders.notes: Core identity, status, dates and summary scope confirmed from the NLA's own page. Deliverables list, mandatory conditions, eligibility, evaluation criteria, tender documents, value and contact could not be captured because the detail page and documents were unreachable this run (egress block). Needs a full detail/deliverables pass once network access is restored. A separate NLA forward item, 'Mechanical, Electrical & Motorised Shelving Maintenance' (estimated ATM Oct-Dec 2026), is a different notice.
